heights.encoding: gzip of int16le; rows north to south, west to east; each value the difference from the one to its west

clearing.encoding: 8-bit grey PNG, rows north to south, west to east: the signed distance from each 4 m pixel's middle to the nearest building, (byte - zero) × unitM metres, negative inside

stands.encoding: gzip of bytes, 4 a pixel, rows north to south, west to east: the shares of pine, spruce and birch, 0 to 255, what's left being other broadleaf, then the share of lattice places holding a tree

water.encoding: coded as the heights are: the drawn water surface at each height node, dryLevel where no water is near; and the metres from the shore, out into the water and below zero on land

attribution: Land: National Land Survey of Finland (elevation, orthophotos, laser scanning, 3D buildings, Topographic Database), CC BY 4.0
Forest stands: ©Natural Resources Institute Finland, 2023, The Multi-source National Forest Inventory Raster Maps of 2023, CC BY 4.0

rock.encoding: gzip of bytes, rows north to south, west to east: each pixel's share of rock, 0 to 255, then at fieldPixels each pixel's share of boulder field
